messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API p99 latency spike (us-east-1). queued_requests=14k (>10k threshold), gpu_pool_util=98%, autoscaler_status=ERROR. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/hosted-queue-surge>

sre-oncall-ash: ack, I'm looking. Seeing heavy fanout from a customer campaign in us-east.

maria-eng: confirming logs show provisioner failing with 403 quota error when creating new GPU instances: 
```
provisioner.create_pool: error=QuotaExceeded, message="Exceeded GPU instance quota for project"
```

ops-lead-jon: outline: if autoscaler can't spin up, we need fallback routing to dedicated pools and enable degraded mode. @maria-eng can you check fallback policies?

maria-eng: fallback routing configured but current policy excludes some heavy customers. I can flip to broader fallback in 2 mins.

support-jen: support queue: multiple customers reporting timeouts and p99s > 20s. Most affected: small-tenant apps on hosted plan. Notifying top 5 customers now.

eng-ml-tom: mitigation idea: enable model-variant downgrade for non-critical requests to reduce GPU mem pressure (gpt-medium -> gpt-small). Quick flag: model_variant=allow_fallbacks=true

sre-oncall-ash: doing actions in parallel: 1) flip fallback routing to include heavy tenants 2) enable model downgrade policy 3) kick manual pool creation with different region as temporary. Executing now.

maria-eng: changed routing rules. Added rule: route when queued_requests>5k -> dedicated-fallback-us-east/burst. Pushed.

sre-oncall-ash: enabling downgrade policy: `POST /admin/flags {"model_downgrade": "enabled"}`

ops-lead-jon: manual pool creation attempt fails with same 403. Need cloud-quotas team escalation.

maria-eng: filing cloud quota ticket and paging cloud-op oncall. Ticket: CLD-7891. ETA unknown.

product-liz: what's customer impact? any paying customers timing out? need comms draft.

support-jen: 3 paying accounts hitting retries/timeouts, a few trial accounts degraded. I'm drafting a status message for affected tenants.

eng-ml-tom: we've reduced p95 from 3.8s -> 1.9s on test path after routing changes but p99 still elevated due to backlog drains.

sre-oncall-ash: current metrics: queued_requests=6.2k -> halved since routing, gpu_util=92%, p99=9.4s -> trending down. Continue monitoring.

maria-eng: eviction policy in place for idle background jobs to free up instances; manually evicted non-critical batch jobs across a handful of tenants.

ops-lead-jon: good. Next: prepare for handoff in 30m. If cloud quota not resolved, we need to plan a temporary rate-limit on hosted free tier to protect SLAs for paid customers.

support-jen: agree. I'll segment affected accounts and prepare tiered messages. Also collecting error traces to attach.

sre-oncall-ash: telemetry note: autoscaler error path: provisioner.retry loop hitting quota, then marking leader dead and not retrying due to safety gate. Need a change to allow bounded backoff retries for quota errors.

maria-eng: filing infra followup: INFRA-412 backlog: add bounded-retry for quota errors and better metrics when leader enters safety gate.

eng-ml-tom: follow-up: propose a new cache-friendly knob to lower memory per-request for short responses, should reduce pressure for similar spikes.

ops-lead-jon: agreed. For now maintain fallbacks. @product-liz please hold on comms until we have clearer ETA. We can send interim "investigating" notice.

product-liz: drafting interim status now: short note — investigating elevated latencies in us-east affecting some hosted customers; mitigation in progress; will update in 30m.

sre-oncall-ash: handing off to night shift: @maria-eng (night-oncall) will take primary, I'm leaving runbook notes and actions executed. Key items: fallback enabled, downgrade policy enabled, cloud ticket CLD-7891 open, INFRA-412 filed.

maria-eng: ack takeover. Will monitor queue, coordinate with cloud-op, and escalate if p99 > 10s or queued_requests > 3k.

support-jen: passing to night support, all customer messages queued. Shared list of affected account IDs in the incident doc.

inc-bot: Incident severity updated to SEV-2. Duration so far: 00:25:02. Paging schedule: @maria-eng active, on-call rotations will escalate to ops-lead-jon if unresolved in 60m.

maria-eng: thanks. I will keep thread updated. If cloud quota clears, we'll scale back fallbacks and disable downgrade after backlog drains.
